nodes.name: Every 10 min, 07:00-23:59
nodes.notes: Deliberately not 24/7. Render free allows ~750 instance-hours a month and always-on is ~730, which would exhaust the allowance and suspend the service before month end. A 17-hour window is ~527 hours and leaves real margin. Times follow the n8n instance timezone - set it under Settings if it is not already IST.

nodes.name: Wake API
nodes.notes: /health, not /actuator/health. This path touches nothing, so it wakes the web service without also waking Neon and spending its compute hours. A 90s timeout because a cold JVM start takes 40-60s - a short timeout aborts the request before the wake completes.

nodes.name: Check UI
nodes.notes: Availability check only. Render static sites have no instance to stop, so they never sleep and this does not keep anything alive - it just tells you if the site stopped serving.
